answer: The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Reaching the nebula of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The prism holds work receipts rather than names, so the vine of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
